name: clawd-companion
description: An animated mascot that reacts to Claude Code in a small local window and in the status line. Local only.

display_name.title: Your name
display_name.description: What Clawd calls you in the welcome and the water reminder. Leave empty to use the name setup asked for, or none.

clawd_color.title: Clawd colour
clawd_color.description: Clawd's body colour in the status line and the companion window. A colour set for the model you use wins over this one.

opus_color.title: Opus colour
opus_color.description: Clawd's colour while you use a Opus model. none uses Clawd colour.

sonnet_color.title: Sonnet colour
sonnet_color.description: Clawd's colour while you use a Sonnet model. none uses Clawd colour.

haiku_color.title: Haiku colour
haiku_color.description: Clawd's colour while you use a Haiku model. none uses Clawd colour.

hydration_interval_minutes.title: Hydration interval (minutes)
hydration_interval_minutes.description: Minutes between hydration reminders, measured from the end of the last one.

hydration_display_seconds.title: Hydration display (seconds)
hydration_display_seconds.description: How long each hydration reminder stays on screen.

confirm_ttl_minutes.title: Confirmation timeout (minutes)
confirm_ttl_minutes.description: Fallback: drop the attention state if nothing clears it within this long.

session_idle_timeout_minutes.title: Session idle timeout (minutes)
session_idle_timeout_minutes.description: Forget a session that has not sent an event for this long.

status_style.title: Status line style
status_style.description: sprite draws a small two-row pixel Clawd, text prints one plain line, off prints nothing.

window_mode.title: Companion window mode
window_mode.description: tab opens your default browser, app tries a Chromium app-style window and falls back to tab.

auto_open.title: Open the window automatically
auto_open.description: Start the server and open the companion window when a session starts.

port.title: Companion port
port.description: Preferred port on 127.0.0.1. If busy, the next free port is used.

sound_enabled.title: Allow sound and notifications
sound_enabled.description: Show the Enable sound button in the window. Still requires a click and browser permission.

menu_bar.title: Menu bar Clawd (macOS only)
menu_bar.description: Show Clawd in the Mac menu bar and a notification when Claude Code needs your approval. Built on your Mac the first time. Does nothing on Windows or Linux.
